payout_value_note: $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward Card to the referrer and $50 to the friend. Referrer capped at $500 per year.
payout_quote: Earn $50 Every Time You Refer Someone* ... You both get a $50 Mastercard Virtual Reward Card when they open a new Independent Bank checking account and meet the requirements. ... You can earn up to $500 per year.
steps: Register on the Independent Bank refer-a-friend page to get a personal referral link.
Send the link via email, text, or social media.
Friend registers, opens a new Independent Bank personal or business checking account ($10 minimum deposit).
Friend completes 10 debit card transactions (ATM excluded) OR at least $100 in direct deposit within 60 calendar days of account opening.
Rewards mailed to the address on file after the friend completes the required tasks.
catches: Rewards are Mastercard Virtual Reward Cards, not cash.
Friend must complete 10 debit transactions or $100 in direct deposit within 60 days.
Rewards subject to 1099-INT (referred) / 1099-MISC (referrer) for aggregate awards totaling $600 annually.
Run through the ReferLive program; each party may become aware the other is a customer.
biggest_catch: Capped at $500/year, and rewards are virtual prepaid cards rather than cash — plus 1099 reporting once awards total $600.
eligibility: Independent Bank customers; friend must open a new eligible checking account.
timing: Link sharing ~5 min active; rewards mailed after the friend completes the 60-day requirements.
